provenance: Lyrics transcribed verbatim from the Suno song pages on 2026-09-30 (read-only library read): 'Patch Notes v3' (V6-MINI, 2:54) and 'Patch Notes v3.5' (V6-MINI, 3:05) display identical lyric text — this file covers both renders.

lines: I rewrote the morning with the curtains half-drawn
Faced down the list I'd been putting off too long
Every open tab held a piece of the weight
Every "one more day" kept adding to the wait
But the work was still there when the panic moved on
So I gave it an hour, then another till dawn
No movie montage, no lightning-strike scene
Just a hand on the wheel and the will to lean in
sections.name: Verse 1

lines: I don't have to be somebody new overnight
Just show up today and get one thing right
sections.name: Pre-Chorus

lines: These are my patch notes
I'm not who I was
I kept the scars, kept the lessons
Turned the pressure into trust
These are my patch notes
No perfect design
Just rewriting the code
Of a life that feels like mine
sections.name: Chorus

lines: Patch notes
New skin
Same soul
Begin again
sections.name: Drop Hook

lines: Now the goals on the wall don't feel far out of range
They're the proof that the small days add up to change
And the person I needed was never ahead
He was made in the mornings I wanted to run
sections.name: Verse 2

lines: No final version, no end of the road
Just a lighter version of the heavy load
Every scar's a feature, every fall's a fix
The broken parts were part of it
sections.name: Bridge
